messages:
maria: Ugh CI red on my PR (4189) after merging shared-protos. pre-commit + rustfmt + mypy all failed on the same run. anyone free to help quick-triage? :grimacing:

jack: I can take a look in a few. Do you have the failing log paste? Is it a formatting diff or type error?

maria: Paste from the lint job: 
```
rustfmt failed: Diff in src/protos/mod.rs
- pub mod user_one;
+pub mod user_one;

mypy: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "str", variable has type "Optional[bytes]") at infra/schemas.py:72
pre-commit: hooks failed: black, isort, mypy
```

olivia: Hmm looks like two separate problems collided. The rustfmt diff is just whitespace (maybe a generated file change). mypy error seems real — maybe the proto change changed types that downstream code assumes.

tyler: Could be that the generator changed and we didn't regenerate the generated Python stubs. Did the PR touch the .proto -> python generation script?

maria: I only changed a field name in user.proto and updated the go generator config, forgot to run python regeneration. Sorry, brain fart.

jack: No worries. Two quick things: (1) We can rerun only the lint/format jobs after you push the regenerated files. (2) If you want me to bisect, give me the commit range. Otherwise a tiny fix + targeted rerun should be fastest.

maria: I'll regenerate and push. To confirm: which job to rerun? CI has a lot. I don't want to trigger a full matrix.

olivia: Rerun these jobs: `format`, `lint`, `typecheck`. On Circle/GitHub Actions you can rerun a workflow file or specific job names. If you don't have permission I can trigger the rerun.

tyler: If you prefer a bisect (in case this was a flaky pre-commit pin), use: `git bisect start HEAD~10 HEAD -- script/run-precommit-checks.sh` — but only if this recurs. For regens, just run `tools/gen_protos.py && pre-commit run --all-files` locally.

maria: Pushed regenerated Python stubs and ran `pre-commit run --all-files` locally, all green. Pushed commit 5f3a9b to the branch. Can someone rerun the lint/typecheck jobs?

jack: Kicking off targeted rerun now. @sre-bot can you do the targeted rerun for jobs `format,lint,typecheck` on branch? :pray:

sre-bot: Scheduled: rerun jobs [format, lint, typecheck] for PR #4189. CI URL: https://ci.example.com/1796012345/reruns/3

olivia: If the rerun still fails, let's avoid a full repo bisect until we confirm — might be a pre-commit pin difference. For now, if CI passes we'll merge and I can follow up with a checklist item to regenerate stubs when proto changes land.

maria: Thanks all — will watch CI. If it flakes again I'll ask for a formal bisect. :thumbsup:

jack: Quick note for the future: add `tools/gen_protos.py` to the PR checklist for any proto edits. Saves the whole team a 10-minute ping chain.

maria: Filed a tiny PR template checklist update: "regen python protos". Done.

sre-bot: Rerun complete: all specified jobs passed. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
